title: centaurea scabiosa subsp. cephalariifolia
intro: Centaurea scabiosa subsp. cephalariifolia, commonly known as Mountain Cornflower or Cephalari Cornflower, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, characterized by its blue flowers and narrow leaves. The health benefits of Centaurea scabiosa subsp. cephalariifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea scabiosa subsp. cephalariifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
